chunks: Ilal al-Shara'i: From his father from Sa'd from Ibn Yazid from Hammad from Al-Huriz from Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Burayd, they said:

A man said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): I have a son, and I wish for him to ask you about the Halal and the Haram, and not to ask you about that which does not concern him? He said: And do people ask about a subject better than the Halal and the Haram?!
ai.seo_question: What is the best subject for a student to ask an Imam about?
ai.summary: A man expresses his desire for his son to ask Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the permissible and the forbidden, avoiding irrelevant matters. The Imam affirms this by asking rhetorically if there is any subject superior to knowing the Halal and the Haram, highlighting the centrality of these two concepts in religious knowledge.

en.ammaar-muslim: 5. [5/32] Ilal al-Sharai: From my father (Ali b. al-Husayn b. Babawayh) from Sa’d from Ibn Yazid from Hammad from Hariz from Zurara and Muhammad b. Muslim and Burayd all of whom said:

a man said to Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: I have a son – I do wish for him to ask you about the Halal and the Haram and not about that which does not concern him, so he said: and do the people ask about a subject better than the Halal and the Haram?!
